population: All supported condition means in each declared source, fixed across models; no cell-count weighting
primary_metric: equal-condition mean squared error over the frozen gene vocabulary
comparison: paired errors on identical outer biological-group folds; source-only inner selection; descriptive group bootstrap
confirmation: none; existing pilot is exposed and new public single source is development

reliability.status: experimental; requires separate risk-fit, calibration and fresh evaluation groups

capacity: No scaling or routing unless a learned candidate improves the strongest matched simple reference by at least 5% on development
pretraining: No external expression or descriptor pretraining; downstream source singles pretrain staged encoders; no-pretraining and frozen/fine-tuned comparisons retain the same labels
extensions: Dose, identity-only unknown interventions, higher-order and temporal claims are unsupported unless separately source-qualified
